title: Leo Music Studio v10.3.9 — BetterLyrics 2.0, 3D Curved Glass, Moveable Dynamic Bar & 10.3.3–10.3.9 Bug Fixes
notes:
• Added BetterLyrics 2.0 (Word-by-Word Fluid Glow Sweep, Active Line 1.18x Zoom, Vocal-Beat Breathing Aura, 1-Click Copy & Re-Fetch LRC)
• Added 4 Selectable Full-Screen Studio Modes: 3D Split + Lyrics, Full-Screen Cinema Lyrics, Concert Visualizer Stage, and Smart Queue Deck
• Added 3D Curved Convex Lens Glass Effect (✦ 3D Curved Glass: ON/OFF) + Always-On-Top Moveable Dynamic Bar Overlay (Compact Pill & Expanded 3D Pod)
• Fixed all v10.3.3–v10.3.9 bugs: GDI+ Region handle leak, TopMost Alt+Tab Z-order drop, VBR lyrics drift, rapid-skip crossfade overlap, and filter race conditions
